description: Declare (or replace the schema of) a table in this tenant's state store. schema is {"column": "text"|"integer"|"real"|"boolean"|"json"}; primary_key, if given, must name one of schema's columns -- an insert whose row matches an existing row's primary_key value replaces it.

name.description: Table name to declare, or replace the schema of.

primary_key.description: Column name (must be in schema) whose matching value replaces an existing row on insert; optional.

schema.description: Column name to type map, each type one of text|integer|real|boolean|json, e.g. {"id": "integer"}.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

name: host.state.table_create
